name: Ui_MapWindow_ShowLocationBanner
summary: Shows the current location banner: reads the area id at saveWork+0x2D2C, resolves the area record and hands its talk data to Ui_MessageWindow_ShowTalkData or builds the display-param block and calls Ui_MessageWindow_ShowFieldData, after applying the window layout.
evidence: Body branches on saveWork+0x2D2C == -1 and calls Ui_MessageWindow_ShowTalkData/Ui_MessageWindow_ShowFieldData with a 0x3F4CCCCD scale descriptor; callees include Map_ResolveJumpLocationId and Event_ApplyScenarioJumpSettings.

name: maybe_Model_Actor_UpdateAttachmentVisibility
summary: Compares a data-table visibility result (0x0063DAD4 on f_3B0/f_3B4) with the cached byte f_31C and shifts attached part blocks when it changes; only caller is Ui_Marker_FollowActor.
evidence: Single named caller Ui_Marker_FollowActor; data-table lookup plus cached f_31C comparison; the 'attachment' reading is still inferred.

name: maybe_Menu_ShowRowDescriptionPopup
summary: Toggles the description popup of the selected menu row: sets the popup flag when idle/open, closes it if sub-state at menu+0x3DE8 is 3, otherwise fills a window descriptor from the row data and shows it via Ui_MessageWindow_ShowTalkData.
evidence: Reads row through maybe_Ui_Window_GetRowData, builds 0xFFFF/0.8 descriptor and calls Ui_MessageWindow_ShowTalkData; no item record resolution.

name: maybe_Event_CameraZoomTask_Update
signature: void maybe_Event_CameraZoomTask_Update(CameraZoomTask* task, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Two-step task on a float field of the field object's attached view: step 1 saves the current value (+0x9C) into task+4, adds the delta from task+8 and flags the child; step 2 decays the delta by 0.8 per frame until below 0.5 and re-applies base+delta.
evidence: Decay constant 0x3F4CCCCD and 0.5 threshold verified; target is (work+8)->f_54->f_20->f_210+0x9C, but whether that value is a zoom is unconfirmed.

name: maybe_Ui_List_BuildRowsB
signature: u32 maybe_Ui_List_BuildRowsB(u32 self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Body is 2.2 KB of overlapping Thumb instructions with unaff_ registers; callee set matches the 0x0030B120 resource loader (Fs_NamedObject_LoadSimple, Pack_HandlePair_MoveAssign/Pack_ReleaseHandle), so it is not a list row builder.
evidence: Instruction overlaps and unaff_ registers; callees are resource/pack loaders; no named caller uses it as a row builder.

name: Model_LoadVariant
signature: u32 maybe_Model_LoadVariant(UiModelSlot* self, u32 key, u32 variant)
summary: Loads a model variant: builds the name from the type byte at self+0xB (0x10 selects self+0xA) and slot data at self+8, looks up the model, computes frame size from self+0x20..+0x24 and assigns the loaded handle to self+0x20.
evidence: Callers Gfx_MeshObject_ApplySetupParams and Model_AttachSlot_InitResource; callees Fs_NamedObject_LoadSimple, Pack_HandlePair_MoveAssign, Anim_BuildMotionPackPath, Container_Vector_PushBack fit a model/resource loader.

name: maybe_Ui_Pack_LoadLayout
signature: int maybe_Ui_Pack_LoadLayout(UiPackOwner* self, unsigned packName, char* name)
summary: Opens a UI layout pack for a screen: builds the '<name>.pack' path with 0x006F0C10, opens/loads the pack and swaps the cached handle into self->f_828.
evidence: Ghidra could not recover register arguments (unaff_ registers); '%s.pack' literal and pack-manager callees are the only support; callers include PictureCardMove and Item_SelectCategory.

name: Ui_Effect_AssignHandleById
summary: Assigns the effect/resource selected by id to self+8: releases the old handle, lazily creates the 0x21C-byte pooled object, resolves the id through Fs_NamedObject_LoadSimple with a 0xC-byte descriptor and stores the new handle.
evidence: Body is a handle assignment (release old, load by id, store) rather than a constructor; callers Ui_Pane_CreateEffectForItemId, Ui_Window_RefreshEffect, Ui_MonsterBook_SelectModel treat the result as the pane/window's current effect.

name: maybe_Ui_DebugMenu_SetPageState
summary: Resets the 0x21C-byte UI scene singleton, drives the scene-transition manager and movie player, then clears the page state; the debug-menu label is unconfirmed.
evidence: Calls Ui_GetCore vtable +0x28, Ui_GetSceneTransitionManager, Gfx_Movie_PlayByName, maybe_Ui_Anim_SetStateId; no debug-menu literal or named caller.

name: maybe_Ui_SceneFlow_CreateSlot
summary: One-shot init of the 0x21C-byte UI scene object: allocates/zeroes it, attaches shader_bch, registers system objects, skipped while loading screen active.
evidence: Gfx_ResourceList_Attach, Script_RegisterSystemObjects, Ui_LoadingScreen_IsActive, vtable 0x007829E0 shared with 0x0066D0D0; no named caller.

name: maybe_Ui_Scene_EnsureCreated
summary: Lazily creates the shared 0x21C-byte UI scene object when the init byte is set, then returns the negation of Ui_LoadingScreen_IsFinished (still loading).
evidence: Allocator/vtable pair identical to 0x00623914; returns Ui_LoadingScreen_IsFinished()^1; no named caller.

name: maybe_Gfx_ResourceHandle_Init
signature: u32 maybe_Gfx_ResourceHandle_Init(void* handle, u32 allocator, ResourceDesc* desc)
summary: Allocates the 0xC0-byte resource object and copies the default block, or builds the 0x50-byte fallback via 0x005ABEB4; returns 1/0.
evidence: Mem_AllocAligned_2(0xc0), std_ConstructArray, Anim_KeyframeTrack_EvaluateAll, Anim_ModelInstance_Release; callers are UI update paths, so resource type unclear.

name: maybe_Resource_ReleaseChildObject
summary: Releases the child object at +8 (release, destroy 0x14-entry array, free) and nulls the pointer; same body as the failure path inside 0x003D15C4.
evidence: Identical sequence to the cleanup branch of 0x003D15C4 (Anim_ModelInstance_Release, std_destroy_range 0x005646E4, free, store 0); 'Event_Packet' label unsupported.

name: maybe_Battle_Manager_UpdateCommandState
summary: Per-frame state machine advancing battle command/target selection, driving target markers and window-idle checks.
evidence: Neighbours Ui_BattleTargetMarker_UpdatePositions/ReleaseAll/CreateFromModelId, Ui_Window_IsGroupIdle, Battle_Ui_GetMemberAnchor; state ids 0xFFB..0x1020 unnamed.

name: maybe_Battle_SceneInit_Shared
signature: void* maybe_Battle_SceneInit_Shared(u32 owner, u32 parameter, u32 parameter2, u32 parameter3)
summary: Battle-scene setup: allocates helper objects, installs the two unit-model vtables (0x7759FC/0x775AB8) and links camera/animation/text objects.
evidence: Only caller BattleScene_AllocUnitModelSlot; installs g_battleUnitModelBVtable/B; Mem_AllocAligned_2, Model_BindResourceSlots, Gfx_Node_CreateChild.
